question: What is EIP-4844
answer: EIP-4844, or Proto-Danksharding, is a pivotal proposal to enhance Ethereum’s scalability and data availability.

claims.text: While Danksharding is still years away, Proto-Danksharding (EIP-4844) provides immediate scalability and has been implemented on all testnets and went live on Mainnet with the Cancun-Deneb upgrade in March 2024.
